git_checkpoints.empty_checkpoint: Push pending commits and verify synchronization; no empty commit
git_checkpoints.branch_policy: Use current intended branch; currently main

location_preference_source.text: only search for federal government jobs. limited to DMV (DC, Maryland and virginia), all other searching criteria remain the same

location_policy.remote: Include only if work from Maryland/DMV is permitted without regular distant-office attendance
location_policy.multi_location: Include if a Maryland, Virginia or DC office is an offered work location
location_policy.relocation: Do not assume or search nationwide on-site/hybrid roles
location_policy.boundary: Only DC, Maryland and Virginia; no surrounding communities outside these jurisdictions

resume_output_policy.source: User instruction on 2026-11-01: generate pdf file for each customized resume under a meaningfully named folder

document_label_policy.scope: Resume body, headings, headers/footers and editable document metadata in all generated formats
document_label_policy.preparation_notes_location: match.md, application.json, ledger and log; retain existing meaningful filenames/folders
document_label_policy.source: User instruction on 2026-11-01: no AI-update marks or tailored/targeted-to-position wording on resumes

employer_scope: Federal government agencies only; exclude private employers, federal contractors, GSEs, and state/local government employers

preparation_policy.missing_required_answers: Continue all independent preparation; ask for missing facts before completing the affected fields or declarations
